description: List this organization's saved templates. Follow pagination.nextCursor with after to read further pages. Public catalog slugs are not enumerated here; read a known public slug with get_template.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `pagination.nextCursor`. Forward-only.

limit.description: Page size (1..100), default 20. Out-of-range or unparseable clamps into the range.

name: list_templates
title: List Templates
